headline: Jamaat-e-Islami's 11-party divisional rally in Barisal on Saturday
summary: Jamaat-e-Islami is set to host a significant divisional rally in Barisal this Saturday, reportedly as part of an 11-party alliance.
details: Jamaat-e-Islami is preparing to hold its divisional rally in Barisal on Saturday. The event is a key political gathering for the party in the region.

Banners at the rally site indicate that the event is being organized under the banner of an '11-party alliance' for the Barisal division. This suggests a broader coalition participating in the assembly.
caption:
Jamaat-e-Islami, alongside an 11-party alliance, will hold a major divisional rally in Barisal this Saturday.

headline_marked: Charmonai Pir: [[State must take responsibility for eradicating drug supply line]]
headline: Charmonai Pir: State must take responsibility for eradicating drug supply line
summary: Charmonai Pir has urged the government to prioritize the complete elimination of drug distribution networks across the nation.
details: Charmonai Pir, a prominent religious leader, has called upon the government to assume full responsibility for eradicating the drug supply chain within the country.
He emphasized the critical need for state intervention to dismantle the networks facilitating drug distribution, highlighting it as a national imperative.
caption:
A prominent religious leader has issued a strong call to the state regarding drug eradication.

Charmonai Pir, a prominent religious leader, has called upon the government to assume full responsibility for eradicating the drug supply chain within the country.

He emphasized the critical need for state intervention to dismantle the networks facilitating drug distribution, highlighting it as a national imperative.
